about.lead: A decade running the numbers behind West Africa's largest construction and infrastructure — now working where AI, strategy and finance meet.
body: Joseph Khaouly is a finance executive who effectively served as holding-company CFO of a diversified Lagos investor group — across heavy civil engineering, façade engineering, energy trading, catering, coal mining and a luxury hotel — long before he moved to Julius Berger Nigeria, a construction multinational roughly twenty times that group's scale.

He has centralised finance across seven companies, structured and registered a corporate bond programme on Nigeria's FMDQ market, co-led negotiations of a $75M residential joint venture, and advised a group chairman directly on capital allocation and strategy.

In 2025 he relocated to Amsterdam and made a deliberate pivot: formalising a second discipline in applied AI through Oxford's Saïd Business School and UT Austin's McCombs School — a technical complement to his HEC Liège finance training, not a gloss on it.

track.detail: Commercial strategy and financial control for Region West infrastructure (turnover ~$500M+). Helped stand up the company's new Benin Republic branch; cut project overheads 15% through value-engineering.

track.role: Personal Advisor to the Chairman & Group CFO
track.detail: Co-led negotiations on the $75M Signature Tower JV (232 apartments), Eko Atlantic City. Designed centralised shared services across seven companies; advised on portfolio, asset sales and capital budgeting.

Treasury, bank facilities and the structuring of a corporate bond programme to Nigeria's FMDQ market, across heavy civil, façade, energy and catering. As MD & CFO of a luxury hotel, doubled turnover and grew net profit 60% through COVID.
Restructured the practice into accounting, audit, tax and advisory verticals; led feasibility studies, valuations and business plans for SME clients.

projects.name: REA — Assistant
projects.tagline: REA (Real Estate Assistant) tracks the financial performance of the property you own and runs the rent billing for the property you manage on behalf of others. The two are computed in complete isolation, so managed assets never distort the returns on your own capital.

meth.v: Real estate management · Investment performance analytics
Isolated ledgers per asset class, with per-transaction FX-rate capture
Owned and managed assets are never mixed; every cross-currency entry is rate-verified at the transaction date

projects.name: CFO Flash
projects.tagline: CFO Flash turns a company's period financials — P&L, budget-vs-actual, balance sheet — into a four-section decision memo (health, risks, decisions, questions) in seconds. It runs entirely on your own server, so data never leaves the building, and every number comes from deterministic, auditable calculations, not AI guesswork.

meth.v: Deterministic accounting engine + thin LLM narration layer — the engine computes, the model only writes prose
Auditable, not hallucinated — covenant-aware, runs on your own infrastructure, swappable LLM
